landingPage.paragraph1: This Nuxt template is built on Clean Architecture and Modular Design. It gives you a solid, scalable foundation for web apps that are well-structured, easy to maintain, and ready to grow.
landingPage.paragraph2: Ideal for teams who want a production-ready starter with clear module boundaries. Easy to extend, test, and ship. Enjoy building! 🚀
landingPage.structureDetails:
- src/_core: DI, HTTP, theme, network, module init
- src/_shared: shared features (landing, widgets)
- src/modules: feature modules (auth, …)
  • domain / data / features
- src/pages: thin route wrappers
- src/app: Nuxt shell (layouts, plugins)
- i18n/locales: translations (en, ar, zh, es)
landingPage.gettingStartedDetails:
1. Clone the repo from GitHub
2. Run `npm install`
3. Start with `npm run dev`
4. Build features under `src/modules/`
landingPage.techStackDetails:
⚡ Nuxt 4 + Vue 3
🧭 File-based routing (pages/)
🌐 ofetch HTTP client
🧩 tsyringe dependency injection
🎨 Tailwind + design tokens (light/dark)
🌍 Nuxt I18n (en, ar, zh, es)
landingPage.featuresDetails:
✅ Auth module sample (login flow)
✅ Modular clean architecture
✅ Light and dark theme
✅ Localization: English, Arabic, Chinese, Spanish
✅ Responsive layout
landingPage.paragraph3:
We welcome contributions of all kinds!
Fork the repo, make changes, and open a pull request.
